narr: Locally heavy rainfall produced significant roadway flooding and led to a roof collapse of a community center in Melbourne.
ev: Heavy rainfall of 2 to 4 inches fell within approximately an hour and a half in Melbourne. The extreme rain rate led to a roof collapse at the Joseph N. Davis Community Center on Bruce D Buggs St. Twenty people were reportedly inside at the time but were not injured. Significant roadway flooding was also reported near the Florida Institute of Technology campus. Several vehicles were disabled in standing water near Southgate Blvd and Babcock St. A portion of Babcock St was temporarily closed due to flooding.
